jobs.title: VP of IT - Business Applications
jobs.description:
Vice President, IT and Digital Transformation

This is a senior IT and digital transformation leadership role, and it is first and foremost an enterprise applications and ERP leadership role. You will lead technology for a manufacturing business that grew through acquisition and runs multiple independent operating units, each with its own leadership, its own P&L, and in many cases its own systems. The mission is to consolidate and modernize a fragmented applications and ERP landscape, get the underlying data clean and usable, put practical AI to work on top of it, and earn the trust of the business-unit leaders to make it stick. It is a role for a leader who came up through ERP and business applications and wants a career-defining transformation to run.

Compensation:
$250,000 to $285,000 base, plus bonus and long-term incentives.
Logistics:
Remote with travel, US-based

Here's what you'll be doing:

Own the strategy, consolidation, and lifecycle of ERP and enterprise applications across multiple operating businesses, including modernizing legacy and fragmented ERP environments onto a modern, secure, cloud platform.
Lead full-lifecycle ERP work, whether that is standardization, upgrade, migration, or selective consolidation, balancing a unified platform with each business unit's operational needs.
Build the common data layer beneath those applications, driving data cleanup, normalization, and master-data governance so reporting, analytics, and AI have clean, trustworthy data to run on.
Identify and deliver the high-value, practical AI use cases that fit a regulated manufacturing business, from data-layer automation and knowledge retrieval to proposal generation, demand forecasting, and manufacturing workflow.
Operate as a peer to the business-unit leaders who own their P&L, building the relationships and trust needed to align them behind shared standards and carry the work through at the unit level.
Shape the go-forward people and workforce strategy for IT, deciding where to upskill existing teams, hire, or build a shared central capability, and defining the standard for what good looks like at each site.
Keep the business aligned with enterprise security and compliance standards for a regulated environment.
Lead IT due diligence and integration for future acquisitions.

And what you need to have:

A career built in ERP and enterprise business applications, ideally having come up through ERP or applications management before moving into IT leadership.
Hands-on, full-lifecycle ERP experience across implementation, migration, consolidation, or standardization in multi-site or multi-business environments. Oracle strongly preferred (E-Business Suite, Fusion, or Cloud ERP); SAP S/4HANA, Infor, Epicor, or Microsoft Dynamics also valued.
Depth in the enterprise application and data layer: CRM, MES, PLM, integration and middleware, data warehousing, and master-data management, with a record of turning fragmented, disparate systems into a unified, reporting-ready environment.
Practical experience delivering AI or advanced analytics in an industrial or manufacturing setting, with a focus on data quality, automation, and measurable business outcomes.
10+ years of progressive IT leadership in an engineering-centric, product-development, or manufacturing organization operating across multiple sites or business units.
Experience in a highly regulated manufacturing environment, with working familiarity of CMMC, NIST 800-171, DFARS, and ITAR/EAR export controls.
Experience leading IT through M&A due diligence and post-acquisition integration.
A proven ability to influence and build trust with autonomous business leaders who own their own P&L, aligning them behind shared standards without relying on direct authority.
Strong business and financial acumen.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field; MBA preferred.
US Person status as defined by ITAR is required; ability to obtain and maintain a US security clearance is a plus.
Willingness to travel up to 50% at peak.

No CTC or sponsorship at this time.

Job Description

Position Summary

The Director of IT Audit plays a critical leadership role in shaping the future of technology risk assurance, insight regarding technology risks, and Internal Audit at Wings Credit Union. Reporting to the VP of Internal Audit, this leader is responsible for developing and executing the IT audit strategy while providing independent assurance, advisory services, and risk insights across the organization's technology, cybersecurity, data, and digital environments.

As a key member of the Internal Audit leadership team, the Director of IT Audit partners closely with executive leadership, technology leaders, risk partners, regulators, and the Audit Committee to evaluate and strengthen governance, risk management, and control practices. This leader is responsible for building and leading a high-performing IT Audit function, developing talent, enhancing audit methodologies, and providing assurance over the organization’s readiness for an evolving technology and risk landscape.

This role offers the opportunity to influence enterprise technology risk oversight, build and scale a modern IT audit function, develop future audit leaders, and help shape the future of Internal Audit within a growing and increasingly complex organization.

Essential Functions

IT Audit Strategy & Risk Oversight

Develop and maintain the IT audit universe, risk assessment methodology, and audit strategy to ensure appropriate coverage of technology, cybersecurity, data, operational resilience, and emerging risks.
Lead the development of risk-based audit, advisory, and continuous monitoring plans that align with organizational objectives, regulatory expectations, and evolving risk landscapes.
Evaluate emerging technology, cybersecurity, digital transformation, artificial intelligence, and operational risks to ensure audit coverage remains relevant and forward-looking.
Lead the integration of artificial intelligence, emerging technologies, digital transformation, and operational considerations into audit planning, risk assessments, and assurance strategies.
Establish both short- and long-term audit priorities, resource plans, and capability strategies that support the continued growth of the organization.
Ensure audit approaches remain appropriately aligned to the organization's risk profile, strategic priorities, and technology environment.

Audit Leadership & Execution Excellence

Provide leadership and oversight of the IT Audit portfolio, ensuring engagements are completed efficiently, effectively, and in accordance with Internal Audit methodology and professional standards.
Approve audit scopes, objectives, and resource allocations while serving as an escalation point for complex issues, barriers, and emerging risks.
Monitor audit execution, resource utilization, project milestones, quality standards, and audit plan delivery while proactively identifying and addressing risks to successful delivery.
Ensure high standards of audit quality, consistency, documentation, reporting, and stakeholder engagement across all audit activities.
Drive continuous improvement efforts that enhance audit effectiveness, efficiency, and overall value delivered to the organization.

Leadership, Talent Development & Team Growth

Build, lead, coach, and develop a high-performing IT Audit team capable of supporting current and future organizational needs.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth.
Develop leadership capabilities across the team through coaching, mentoring, succession planning, and meaningful development opportunities.
Assess future talent and capability needs while helping build a scalable audit function designed to support organizational growth.
Champion employee engagement initiatives that strengthen retention, team effectiveness, and performance.

Executive Partnership & Organizational Influence

Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership by providing meaningful insights into technology, cybersecurity, governance, and operational risks.
Translate complex audit results, risk trends, and control observations into practical recommendations that support informed decision-making and business performance.
Build strong relationships across technology, risk, compliance, and business functions while maintaining audit independence and objectivity.
Engage effectively with regulators, external auditors, and governance committees while representing the Internal Audit function with professionalism and credibility.
Partner with leaders across all lines of defense to support effective risk management and continuous improvement efforts.

Audit Innovation & Continuous Improvement

Lead the evolution of audit processes, methodologies, tools, and reporting practices to improve coverage, efficiency, and insight generation.
Lead the development and maturation of Internal Audit's artificial intelligence capabilities, including governance frameworks, audit methodology enhancements, documentation standards, risk assessment integration, assurance strategies, and AI-enabled auditing practices.
Promote the use of data analytics, automation, artificial intelligence, and technology-enabled auditing techniques across the audit lifecycle.
Identify opportunities to modernize the Internal Audit function and implement leading practices that support future-state audit capabilities.
Stay informed on industry developments, regulatory expectations, emerging technologies, and evolving audit practices to ensure continued relevance and effectiveness.

Bank Secrecy Act

Remain knowledgeable of and adhere to Wings policies, procedures, and regulations related to the Bank Secrecy Act.

10+ years' of progressive experience in internal audit, external audit, risk management, regulatory supervision, operational and informational required
3+ years' supervisory experience. required

Mastered ability to lead a risk-based assurance strategy, develop a forward-looking audit pipeline, prioritize work across evolving risks, and influence enterprise-minded decisions that strengthen business outcomes and resiliency.
Deep understanding of operational and technical information systems concepts and controls including network infrastructure, computer operating systems, database management systems, SDLC, change management, IT governance and complex computer applications.

Assess IT capabilities, technical architecture, and resource requirements based on business growth.
Determine priorities for IT investments and key technical projects.
Ensure alignment between IT strategy and the overall corporate strategy.

Optimize infrastructure costs and resource utilization.
